command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== GO084 INSTALL VOLATILE-STATE START GUARD ==='
date -Is; hostname
UNIT=/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service
GUARD=/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh
PRE_PID=$(sudo systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
PRE_ACTIVE=$(sudo systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
echo PRE_ACTIVE=$PRE_ACTIVE PRE_PID=$PRE_PID
tmp=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp" "${tmp}.unit"' EXIT
cat >"$tmp" <<'EOS'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
LC_ALL=C
KONF="${ENTITYOS_STARTSCHUTZ_KONF:-/etc/entityos/entityos.conf}"
ROOTFS_OVERRIDE="${ENTITYOS_STARTSCHUTZ_ROOTFS:-}"
block(){ printf 'START BLOCKIERT -- %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 255; }
if [ -n "$ROOTFS_OVERRIDE" ]; then ROOTFS_RUN="$ROOTFS_OVERRIDE"; else
  [ -r "$KONF" ] || block "Konfiguration $KONF ist nicht lesbar; fluechtiger Ort ist unbekannt."
  ROOTFS_RUN="$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN=//p' "$KONF" | head -1)"
  ROOTFS_RUN="${ROOTFS_RUN#\"}"; ROOTFS_RUN="${ROOTFS_RUN%\"}"
  [ -n "$ROOTFS_RUN" ] || block "ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN fehlt in $KONF."
fi
if [ ! -e "$ROOTFS_RUN" ]; then printf 'START FREI -- %s existiert nicht; kein alter Klon zu verlieren.\n' "$ROOTFS_RUN"; exit 0; fi
[ -d "$ROOTFS_RUN" ] || block "$ROOTFS_RUN existiert, ist aber kein Verzeichnis."
sqlite_header_hex='53514c69746520666f726d6174203300'; gefunden=0; unlesbar=0
pruefe_baum(){ local basis="$1" p kopf; [ -d "$basis" ] || return 0; while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
  kopf="$(od -An -tx1 -N16 "$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n')"; [ "$kopf" = "$sqlite_header_hex" ] || continue
  if ! sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" 'PRAGMA schema_version;' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'UNLESBARER SQLite-Kandidat: %s\n' "$p" >&2; unlesbar=$((unlesbar+1)); continue; fi
  if sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" '.dump' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^INSERT INTO'; then printf 'GEFUELLTER semantischer Zustand: %s\n' "$p" >&2; gefunden=$((gefunden+1)); fi
done < <(find "$basis" -type f -size +99c -print0 2>/dev/null); }
pruefe_baum "$ROOTFS_RUN/root/.local/share/agentzero"
pruefe_baum "$ROOTFS_RUN/root/.local/share/frank"
[ "$unlesbar" -eq 0 ] || block "$unlesbar SQLite-Kandidat(en) im geschuetzten Bereich sind nicht belastbar lesbar."
[ "$gefunden" -eq 0 ] || block "$gefunden gefuellte semantische Zustandsspeicher liegen noch im fluechtigen Klon. Erst Persistenz/Export klaeren, dann starten."
printf 'START FREI -- kein gefuellter semantischer SQLite-Zustand unter agentzero/frank im alten Klon.\n'
EOS
chmod 0755 "$tmp"
sudo install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec/entityos
sudo install -m 0755 "$tmp" "$GUARD"
# Fail closed against unexpected unit drift.
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service')
s=p.read_text()
guard='ExecStartPre=/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh'
needle='ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c 'rm -rf \"$ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN\"; mkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN\")\"; cp -a --reflink=auto \"$ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_BASE\" \"$ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN\"''
if guard in s:
    print('GUARD_ALREADY_WIRED')
elif s.count(needle)==1:
    backup=p.with_name(p.name+'.bak-go084')
    if not backup.exists(): backup.write_text(s)
    s=s.replace(needle, guard+'\n'+needle, 1)
    p.write_text(s)
    print('GUARD_WIRED_BEFORE_DESTRUCTIVE_PRESTART')
else:
    raise SystemExit('REFUSE_UNIT_DRIFT: destructive ExecStartPre exact subject not found once')
PY
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemd-analyze verify "$UNIT" >/tmp/go084-systemd-verify.out 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/go084-systemd-verify.out; exit 1; }
echo '--- WIRED ORDER ---'
sudo grep -n '^ExecStartPre=' "$UNIT"
echo '--- LIVE DISCRIMINATOR (NO RESTART) ---'
set +e
sudo "$GUARD" >/tmp/go084-guard.out 2>/tmp/go084-guard.err
GRC=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/go084-guard.out; cat /tmp/go084-guard.err
echo GUARD_RC=$GRC
[ "$GRC" -eq 255 ] || { echo 'EXPECTED_GUARD_RC_255' >&2; exit 1; }
POST_PID=$(sudo systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
POST_ACTIVE=$(sudo systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
echo POST_ACTIVE=$POST_ACTIVE POST_PID=$POST_PID
[ "$PRE_PID" = "$POST_PID" ] || { echo 'VM_PID_CHANGED_UNEXPECTEDLY' >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$POST_ACTIVE" = "$PRE_ACTIVE" ] || { echo 'VM_ACTIVE_STATE_CHANGED_UNEXPECTEDLY' >&2; exit 1; }
echo '=== PASS: GUARD LIVE-WIRED, VM NOT RESTARTED ==='
